```{r}
#| label: FunctionExtractDat
#| include: false
extractDat <- function( list, path, names, results){
  for(i in 1:length(list)){
    Iter.path <- file.path(paste(path,list[[i]],sep="/"))
    R1_Unsp <- read_xlsx(path=Iter.path,sheet = "R1", range = "B4:M20")
    R1_Sp <- read_xlsx(path=Iter.path,sheet = "R1", range = "O4:V20")
    R1 <- cbind(R1_Unsp, R1_Sp)
    R1 <- R1 |> pivot_longer(cols = 1:length(unique(colnames(R1))),names_to = "Treatment", values_to = "Fluor")
    R1$Treatment <- str_replace(R1$Treatment,"Témoin solvant|Solvent control","FETAX" )
    R1$Treatment <- str_replace(R1$Treatment,"Testo -30µg/L","FETAX Testo" )
    R1 <- R1 |> filter( !str_detect(R1$Treatment,"EE2+| FAD")) |> mutate(Conc= str_extract(Treatment,"\\d+,\\d+|\\d+.\\d+|\\d+"))
    R1$Conc <- str_replace(R1$Conc, ",","\\.") 
    R1[which(is.na(R1$Conc)),"Conc"] <- "0"
    R1$Replicate <- "1"
    
    R2_Unsp <- read_xlsx(path=Iter.path,sheet = "R2", range = "B4:M20")
    R2_Sp <- read_xlsx(path=Iter.path,sheet = "R2", range = "O4:V20")
    R2 <- cbind(R2_Unsp, R2_Sp)
    R2 <- R2 |> pivot_longer(cols = 1:length(unique(colnames(R2))),names_to = "Treatment", values_to = "Fluor")
    R2$Treatment <- str_replace(R2$Treatment,"Témoin solvant|Solvent control","FETAX" )
    R2$Treatment <- str_replace(R2$Treatment,"Testo -30µg/L","FETAX Testo" )
    R2 <- R2 |> filter( !str_detect(R2$Treatment,"EE2+| FAD")) |> mutate(Conc= str_extract(Treatment,"\\d+,\\d+|\\d+.\\d+|\\d+"))
    R2$Conc <- str_replace(R2$Conc, ",","\\.") 
    R2[which(is.na(R2$Conc)),"Conc"] <- "0"
    R2$Replicate <- "2"
    
    R3_Unsp <- read_xlsx(path=Iter.path,sheet = "R3", range = "B4:M20")
    R3_Sp <- read_xlsx(path=Iter.path,sheet = "R3", range = "O4:V20")
    R3 <- cbind(R3_Unsp, R3_Sp)
    R3 <- R3 |> pivot_longer(cols = 1:length(unique(colnames(R3))),names_to = "Treatment", values_to = "Fluor")
    R3$Treatment <- str_replace(R3$Treatment,"Témoin solvant|Solvent control","FETAX" )
    R3$Treatment <- str_replace(R3$Treatment,"Testo -30µg/L","FETAX Testo" )
    R3 <- R3 |> filter( !str_detect(R3$Treatment,"EE2+| FAD")) |> mutate(Conc= str_extract(Treatment,"\\d+,\\d+|\\d+.\\d+|\\d+"))
    R3$Conc <- str_replace(R3$Conc, ",","\\.") 
    R3[which(is.na(R3$Conc)),"Conc"] <- "0"
    R3$Replicate <- "3"
    print(i)
    
    New <- rbind(R1,R2,R3)
    New <- New |> filter(!is.na(Fluor))
    New$Replicate <- as.factor(New$Replicate)
    New$Treatment <- as.factor(New$Treatment)
    New$Fluor <- as.numeric(New$Fluor)
    New$Conc <- as.numeric(as.character(New$Conc))
    New$Compound <- names[i]
    results[[names[i]]] <- New
    
  }
  print(results)
}

```

```{r}
#| label: function_spiked_unspiked
#| include: false

spiked_unspiked <- function(df, resultList){
  for(i in unique(df$Compound)){
    print(paste0(i, "Spiked", sep=" "))
    
    Spiked <- df |> filter(Compound == i &  stringr::str_detect(Treatment, "Testosté|FETAX Testo|\\+ Testosterone") )
    
    Spiked$Conc <- factor(Spiked$Conc, ordered=TRUE, levels=sort(unique(Spiked$Conc)))
    
  
    print(paste0(i, "Unspiked", sep=" "))
    
    Unspiked <- df |> filter(Compound == i &  !stringr::str_detect(Treatment, "Testosté|FETAX Testo| + Testosterone") )
    
    Unspiked$Conc <- factor(Unspiked$Conc, ordered=TRUE, levels=sort(unique(Unspiked$Conc)))
    
    resultList[[paste0(i, "_", unique(Spiked$Country))]][["Spiked"]] <- Spiked
  
    resultList[[paste0(i, "_", unique(Unspiked$Country))]][["Unspiked"]] <- Unspiked
  }
  resultList
}


```

## creating final data object

```{r}
#| label: USAdat1
#| include: false
USA <- list.files(path="./data/REACTIV all data_InkaBroomed/USA/",pattern = "xlsx$")

path <- file.path("./data/REACTIV all data_InkaBroomed/USA/")

CombinedDatUSA <- list()
names <- unlist(stringr::str_extract_all(USA,c("\\d{4}\\D+"))) 
names <- stringr::str_replace(names, "-resultats R|-resultats  R","")
names <- stringr::str_replace(names, "2022-CHG-Marlo-","")
```

```{r}
#| include: false
DataUSA <- extractDat(list=USA, path = path, names = names, results = CombinedDatUSA)

DataUSA <- purrr::map_df(DataUSA,~ dplyr::mutate(.x, Country = "USA"))

CombinedDatUSA <- spiked_unspiked(DataUSA, CombinedDatUSA)

```
